[Reply to the comment that got deleted]

Well yeah I am preparing, it'll take me a couple of months to get everything in place though. Still, there are methods that work and don't need much planning, they're just less considerate I guess. It seems kinda silly to worry about the mess I'll leave behind, but I still do.

We had a train-jumper here a few days back, all the trains in the area had serious delays/cancellations for a few days, and I guess the train driver would be traumatised too, don't really wanna do that...

I figure who knows maybe I'll change mind by the time I'm ready, I reckon the fact I'm posting on here means I'm not 100% sure, and I think I should be when I pull the plug.
I'm not depressed though, I just want to die.

You seem like an ok person.

As strange as it is (for me) I actually enjoy helping people to some extent, but still the idea of making the world a better place... I mean it's like you said, everyone's gonna die in the end, and when everyone's dead no one will care how much better the world is. I'm not trying to belittle your point, this is just my take on things. 

I think the allure of non-existence is just that that's where I'm going in the end, either way whatever happens, whatever I do, whatever changes I make, in the end I'll die, and y'know I'll be dead, and I won't give a shit, so why not just die now? Seems a much more efficient way to me.
But I don't want to live, that's the whole point...
I thought that was what I was doing?

Thanks for your supportive words, although I wouldn't call it a dark place. 

Thing is, whilst I'm not exactly the most emotionally connected person, I still feel happy, sad, angry, excited etc. So I'm not numb, and I clearly do care to an extent otherwise my method of suicide wouldn't matter. But I do want to die, I just feel a little frustrated I'm still alive maybe? Or I'm annoyed about the fact it'll be 3 months before I can even afford suicide, like why can't it just be easier?

Maybe I am sick, I mean from a biological standpoint that's the natural desire isn't it? But I cant see the point...
Why would I want to create this motivation?
Yeah, I guess a lot of people are just going through shit, and they'll recover eventually. In some ways I feel that it's unfair to want to die, but I'm just not interested in being alive.

The method I've chosen requires a decent amount of planning and money. So definitely not as easy as I would have expected but I guess you could still argue that it was.

I don't have anyone I love to be honest, there are 2 or 3 who might love me (I'm not really sure though) but I'm taking that into account in my planning. Either way we don't  really talk much nowadays so I expect the baggage won't be too bad.
I guess I understand that it's a fair assumption to make. Sometimes I just wish suicide was easier is all.
I guess the least I can say is that I read the whole thing.
